title: Assessing Nonlinear Elimination Preconditioning for Trust-Region Phase-Field Fracture
summary: Each quasi-static load step of phase-field fracture is a bound-constrained minimization of a nonconvex, coupled displacement-damage energy under an irreversibility bound on the damage. Monolithic Newton stalls once the nonlinearity localizes at the advancing crack front, and staggered (alternate-minimization) schemes converge slowly there.
